methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $6M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Apis Cor is a seed-stage construction technology company that has raised $5.5M to date. The valuation analysis is constrained by a limited comparable universe: one identified private peer (BotBuilt) and no public comps in the housing and construction technology sector.

Given data limitations, stage-progression methodology provides the primary valuation anchor. Using total capital raised ($5.5M) as a proxy for seed-stage value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $14M. This single-method approach generates a narrow triangulated range of $12M (low) to $16M (high), with $14M as the median.

The analysis supports a valuation between $12M and $16M, centered at $14M. However, material uncertainty remains: the reliance on a single methodology reflects sparse comparable data, and the absence of public trading comps or a larger private peer set limits the ability to validate assumptions around stage-step multiples specific to construction tech. A more robust valuation would require either additional comparable transactions in the sector or forward-looking financial projections to stress-test the stage-based multiple.
